name: Elemental Eye
body:
School divination [see text]; Level druid 3, shaman 3, witch 3

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, F (a small object representing one of the five elements [earth, fire, metal, water, wood])

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Target the focus item

Duration see text (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You infuse the object with divination magics. This allows you to gain the benefits of clairaudience/clairvoyance centered on the infused object for 1 minute per level. The object is considered the sensor for this effect.

Once you have infused the object, you have 1 hour per caster level and can activate its effect as a standard action.

This spell gains the relevant descriptor based on which element is employed.
